title: 存档系统缺陷导致进度丢失
description: 存档系统存在多种问题，包括无法保存、存档损坏、更新导致存档失效、自动保存失效、加载失败等，导致玩家进度丢失。
evidence: it fails to save, so not really playable
the game created all files for a save, but didn't put them into a zip archive and couldn't read this save file
the game got updated and broke my save

evidence_items.quote: the hours played come to a quick halt when the save doesn't work
evidence_items.description: 存档无法正常工作，导致游戏中断
evidence_items.quote_zh: 当存档不能用时，你玩的小时数就会戛然而止

evidence_items.quote: My current save just went in the trash because I can’t recharge tools anymore.
evidence_items.description: 存档损坏，无法再给工具充电，角色卡在尝试将电池插入充电器。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我当前的存档刚刚进了垃圾桶，因为我再也没法给工具充电了。

evidence_items.quote: keep updating the game every week and it causes the save file more problems
evidence_items.description: 频繁更新导致存档文件出现问题
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每周都在更新游戏，这给存档文件造成了更多问题

evidence_items.quote: you could loos a 40 hour run just like that if you can get that far
evidence_items.description: 可能瞬间丢失40小时的存档进度
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你能玩到那么远的话，你可能就这样一下子丢掉40小时的进度

evidence_items.quote: old saves often don't work with new updates
evidence_items.description: 旧存档常与新更新不兼容
evidence_items.quote_zh: 旧存档往往无法兼容新更新

evidence_items.quote: однажды случайно умер и обнаружил, что автосохранение не работало последние 3 часа
evidence_items.description: 自动保存失效，最近3小时进度丢失
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有一次不小心死了，才发现自动保存已经3个小时没工作了

evidence_items.quote: save game breaking bugs
evidence_items.description: 存档损坏的严重bug
evidence_items.quote_zh: 存档损坏的bug

evidence_items.quote: I had to restart my 60 hour save because of this ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ bug
evidence_items.description: 严重bug导致必须重启60小时存档
evidence_items.quote_zh: 因为这个♥♥♥♥♥♥♥的bug，我不得不重新开始我60小时的存档

evidence_items.quote: the game created all files for a save, but didn't put them into a zip archive and couldn't read this save file
evidence_items.description: 游戏创建存档文件但未打包成zip，导致无法读取存档
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏为一个存档创建了所有文件，但没有把它们放进zip压缩包里，然后无法读取这个存档文件

evidence_items.quote: the game would crash if I tried to load a save while already playing
evidence_items.description: 读取存档时崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果我在已经游玩时尝试加载存档，游戏就会崩溃

evidence_items.quote: game breaking bugs that can delete saves or softlock it
evidence_items.description: 破坏游戏的bug可能删除存档或导致软锁
evidence_items.quote_zh: 能删除存档或让游戏卡死的破坏性bug

evidence_items.quote: after game update i cant resume my old game
evidence_items.description: 游戏更新后无法继续旧存档
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏更新后我无法继续我原来的游戏

evidence_items.quote: Некоторые могут заруинить ваш сэйв.
evidence_items.description: 某些bug可能毁掉存档
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有些可能会毁掉你的存档。

evidence_items.description: 存档文件随机损坏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 存档文件随机损坏

evidence_items.quote_zh: 存档无法加载

evidence_items.description: 加载存档时游戏冻结，无法关闭，强制重启电脑
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有百分之五十的概率，当你尝试加载存档时游戏会直接卡死，而且没有关闭游戏的选项，因为它会不断把窗口切回自己，逼得你只能硬重启电脑。

evidence_items.quote: Quite a bit of bugs, some even tied to save files so a full restart doesn't fix it
evidence_items.description: 存在与存档文件绑定的bug，完全重启也无法修复

buggy as f**k for now...

evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你不想因为内存占用超过100%而导致保存时崩溃，你就被迫经常重启

evidence_items.description: 需要时不时重新加载

evidence_items.quote_zh: 保存了游戏去吃午饭，回来时没有存档，只能从头再来

evidence_items.description: 备份也可能损坏

evidence_items.description: 一次灾难性故障摧毁了存档
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我遇到过一次灾难性的故障，毁掉了我的存档

evidence_items.quote: my game would save, but something would go catastrophically wrong, such as loading in without a suit, or I'd randomly fail to dock.
evidence_items.description: 存档后出现严重错误，如加载时没有宇航服或随机对接失败
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我的游戏会保存，但某些东西会灾难性地出错，比如加载时没有宇航服，或者我会莫名其妙地对接失败。

evidence_items.quote: There is only the one save slot and it's easy to overwrite it and wind up with all your effort so far being lost.
evidence_items.description: 只有一个存档槽，容易覆盖导致进度丢失
evidence_items.quote_zh: 只有一个存档槽，很容易覆盖它，导致你迄今为止的所有努力都付诸东流。

evidence_items.quote: I saved in my air-tight, oxygenated and entirely safe ship, and when I reloaded the save I died instantly due to hypoxia
evidence_items.description: 在安全密封的飞船中存档，读档后立即因缺氧死亡
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我在我那艘气密、氧气充足且完全安全的飞船里保存了游戏，而当我重新加载存档时，我因缺氧瞬间死亡。
